annotation_method: Generated synthetic PDFs with manually curated question-to-paper/page/key-phrase labels; labels describe the generated page text, not external papers.
expected_sources: Each retrieval question's target_paper_idx, target_page, and key_phrase in gold_corpus.py; each memory paper fact is anchored to the exact quote on page 4 of its synthetic READY paper.
memory_expected_facts: The active calibration metric is Brier score; the previous AURC decision is superseded.
AdamW uses learning rate 1e-4 and cosine decay.
LaTeX tables use booktabs without vertical rules.
The paper-backed multi-head-attention fact is supported by its page-4 quote and linked element/chunk.

evaluation_config.parser: Docling configured locally; no production/cloud providers
